schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One grouped pull request per week. The value for a project revisited every few months is returning to a single CI-validated update rather than to a wall of forty (docs/ENGINEERING.md).
Auto-merge patch and minor dev-dependency updates. The blast radius is the test suite, and the test suite is what is validating them.

Never auto-merge anything sim depends on. sim's [dependencies] table is empty and docs/RISKS.md R9 is about keeping it that way; a rule that would merge something into it without a human is a rule that defeats the invariant it is protecting.
Major bumps and production dependencies are reviewed. The blast radius is the running server (docs/ENGINEERING.md).

The release image's base, pinned by digest and kept current. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests does this for actions; a distroless tag is the same mutable pointer in the same release pipeline (docs/RISKS.md R12), and the pins have to outlive nothing.
